recipes.name: Crispy roasted potatoes
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) Yukon Gold or red potatoes
1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary or 1 teaspoon dried
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Cut the potatoes into 1 inch chunks. Ask an adult to help with the knife.
Toss with the oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder and rosemary on a baking sheet.
Spread out in one layer with a cut side down.
Roast for 20 minutes, then flip with a spatula.
Roast for 15 to 20 minutes more, until crispy and golden.

recipes.name: Oven-baked fries
steps: Have an adult cut the potatoes into 1/4 inch sticks.
Soak the sticks in cold water for 30 minutes. This makes them crispier.
Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Ask an adult to help.
Drain and dry them really well with towels.
Toss with the oil and spread in one layer on 2 baking sheets.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp.
Toss with salt and garlic powder right away.

recipes.name: Sweet potato fries
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Have an adult cut the sweet potatoes into 1/4 inch sticks.
Toss with the cornstarch until lightly dusted, then with the oil.
Spread them out on 2 lined baking sheets so they do not touch.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, flipping halfway, until crisp at the edges.
Sprinkle with salt and paprika.

recipes.name: Seasoned potato wedges
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Have an adult cut each potato in half lengthwise, then each half into 4 wedges.
Toss with the oil, salt, garlic powder and paprika.
Lay them skin side down on a lined baking sheet.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden and tender inside.
Sprinkle with parmesan and serve.

recipes.name: Cheesy scalloped potatoes
ingredients: 2 1/2 lb (1.1 kg) Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled
1 1/2 cups (170 g) shredded cheddar or Gruyere
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Ask an adult to help.
Have an adult slice the potatoes 1/8 inch thick.
Melt the butter in a pot, whisk in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the milk, add the garlic, salt and pepper, and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until thick.
Layer half the potatoes in a greased 9 by 13 inch dish, pour on half the sauce and sprinkle with half the cheese.
Repeat with the rest.
Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes.
Uncover and bake for 30 minutes more, until golden and the potatoes are tender.
Let rest for 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Crispy smashed potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15 to 20 minutes, until a fork slides in easily. Ask an adult to help drain them.
Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Ask an adult to help.
Put the potatoes on an oiled baking sheet and let cool for 5 minutes.
Press each one flat with the bottom of a glass.
Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with salt and garlic powder.
Roast for 20 to 25 minutes, until crispy and golden at the edges.
Sprinkle with parmesan and parsley.

recipes.name: Hasselback potatoes
ingredients: 4 medium Yukon Gold or russet potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Lay a potato between 2 chopsticks so the knife stops before cutting through.
Have an adult cut thin slices 1/8 inch apart along each potato.
Mix the butter, oil and garlic and brush over the potatoes, getting some between the slices.
Sprinkle with salt and put them in a baking dish.
Roast for 30 minutes, then brush again with the butter.
Roast for 30 to 40 minutes more, until crisp on the edges and soft inside.
Top with chives.

recipes.name: Twice-baked potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Scrub the potatoes, poke them with a fork and bake for 1 hour, until soft.
Let cool for 10 minutes, then have an adult cut them in half lengthwise.
Scoop out the insides, leaving a thin wall of potato in the skins.
Mash the insides with the sour cream, milk, butter, half the cheese, salt and green onions.
Spoon the filling back into the skins and top with the rest of the cheese.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes, until hot and the cheese melts.

recipes.name: Sweet potato casserole
ingredients: 3 lb (1.4 kg) sweet potatoes, peeled and cubed
steps: Boil the sweet potatoes for 15 to 20 minutes, until very soft. Ask an adult to help drain them.
Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Mash with the butter, brown sugar, milk, egg, vanilla, cinnamon and salt until smooth.
Spread in a greased 2 quart baking dish.
Bake for 25 minutes.
Cover the top with the marshmallows and bake for 10 minutes more, until puffed and golden.

recipes.name: Patatas bravas
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) potatoes, cut in 1 inch cubes
Sauce: 1 tablespoon olive oil, 1 garlic clove, minced, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 tablespoon flour, 1/2 cup (120 ml) broth, 1/2 cup (120 g) tomato sauce, 1 teaspoon vinegar, pinch of cayenne
Mayonnaise or garlic aioli to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Toss the potatoes with the oil and salt on a baking sheet.
Roast for 35 to 40 minutes, turning once, until crisp and golden.
For the sauce, warm the oil and garlic in a small pot for 30 seconds. Ask an adult to help.
Stir in the paprika and flour, then whisk in the broth, tomato sauce and vinegar.
Simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, until thick. Add cayenne if you like it spicy.
Spoon the sauce over the potatoes and add dots of mayo.

recipes.name: Bombay potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes for 10 minutes, until just tender. Ask an adult to help drain them.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat and add the cumin and mustard seeds. Cook for 30 seconds, until they sizzle.
Stir in the turmeric, coriander, chili powder and garam masala.
Add the potatoes and tomato and stir to coat.
Cook for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring now and then, until the potatoes are golden at the edges.
Sprinkle with salt and cilantro.

recipes.name: Potato latkes
ingredients: 1/4 cup (30 g) all-purpose flour or matzo meal
Applesauce and sour cream to serve
steps: Grate the potatoes and onion on the big holes of a box grater, keeping fingers clear.
Squeeze handfuls in a clean towel until no more liquid comes out.
Mix with the eggs, flour, salt, pepper and baking powder.
An adult should fry. Heat 1/4 inch of oil in a big frying pan over medium high heat.
Drop 1/4 cup mounds into the oil and flatten them.
Fry for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until deep golden and crisp.
Drain on paper towels and serve with applesauce and sour cream.

recipes.name: Colcannon
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) potatoes, peeled and cubed
4 cups (about 300 g) shredded green cabbage or kale
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 to 20 minutes, until very soft. Ask an adult to help drain them.
Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a pan and cook the cabbage for 5 minutes, until soft.
Mash the potatoes with the warm milk and salt.
Stir in the cabbage and green onions.
Make a dip in the top and add the rest of the butter to melt.

recipes.name: Fluffy white rice
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups (420 ml) water, or 1 1/2 cups (360 ml) for jasmine rice
steps: Rinse the rice in a strainer until the water runs almost clear.
Put the rice, water, salt and butter in a pot and bring to a boil. Ask an adult to help.
Turn the heat to low, cover with a tight lid and cook for 18 minutes. Do not lift the lid.
Turn off the heat and let it sit covered for 10 minutes.
Fluff with a fork.

recipes.name: Rice pilaf
ingredients: 1/2 cup (50 g) broken vermicelli or orzo
2 cups (480 ml) chicken or vegetable broth
steps: Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat. Ask an adult to help.
Add the vermicelli and stir for 2 to 3 minutes, until golden.
Add the rice and stir for 1 minute.
Pour in the broth and salt and bring to a boil.
Cover, turn the heat to low and cook for 18 minutes.
Let sit covered for 5 minutes, then fluff and add parsley.

recipes.name: Cilantro lime rice
ingredients: 1 cup (200 g) long-grain white rice, rinsed
steps: Stir the rice in the oil in a pot over medium heat for 1 minute. Ask an adult to help.
Add the water and salt and bring to a boil.
Cover, turn the heat to low and cook for 18 minutes.
Let sit covered for 5 minutes.
Fluff and stir in the lime zest, lime juice and cilantro.

recipes.name: Mexican rice
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups (420 ml) chicken or vegetable broth
steps: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Ask an adult to help.
Add the rice and stir for 4 to 5 minutes, until light golden.
Add the onion and garlic and stir for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato sauce, broth, cumin and salt and bring to a boil.
Cover, turn the heat to low and cook for 20 minutes.
Let sit covered for 5 minutes, then fluff.

recipes.name: Coconut rice
steps: Put everything in a pot and stir.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring so it does not stick. Ask an adult to help.
Cover, turn the heat to low and cook for 15 to 18 minutes.
Let sit covered for 10 minutes, then fluff.

recipes.name: Jeera rice
steps: Rinse the rice and soak it in water for 20 minutes, then drain.
Melt the ghee in a pot over medium heat and add the cumin seeds and bay leaf. Cook for 30 seconds, until they sizzle. Ask an adult to help.
Add the rice and stir gently for 1 minute.
Add the water and salt and bring to a boil.
Cover, turn the heat to low and cook for 12 to 15 minutes.
Let sit covered for 10 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

recipes.name: Yellow turmeric rice
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups (420 ml) chicken or vegetable broth
steps: Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 3 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Add the rice, turmeric and garlic powder and stir for 1 minute, until the rice is coated and yellow.
Add the broth, salt and bay leaf and bring to a boil.
Cover, turn the heat to low and cook for 18 minutes.
Let sit covered for 5 minutes, take out the bay leaf and fluff.

recipes.name: Seasoned sushi rice
steps: Rinse the rice, swishing with your hand, until the water is almost clear.
Let it soak in the measured water in the pot for 30 minutes.
Bring to a boil, cover, turn the heat to low and cook for 15 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Turn off the heat and let it sit covered for 10 minutes.
Warm the vinegar, sugar and salt for 30 seconds in the microwave and stir until dissolved.
Spread the rice in a big bowl and gently fold in the vinegar mix with a paddle.
Fan it while folding until it is shiny and close to room temperature.

recipes.name: Lemon herb couscous
ingredients: 1 1/4 cups (300 ml) chicken or vegetable broth
steps: Bring the broth, oil and salt to a boil. Ask an adult to help.
Stir in the couscous, cover and take it off the heat.
Let sit for 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and stir in the lemon and parsley.

recipes.name: Fluffy quinoa
steps: Rinse the quinoa well in a fine strainer. This washes off a bitter coating.
Put it in a pot with the water and salt and bring to a boil. Ask an adult to help.
Cover, turn the heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes, until the water is gone.
Let sit covered for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.

recipes.name: Creamy polenta
ingredients: 1 cup (160 g) coarse cornmeal or polenta
steps: Bring the water and salt to a boil in a big pot. Ask an adult to help.
Slowly whisk in the cornmeal so no lumps form.
Turn the heat to low and cook for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring often with a long spoon. It bubbles and spits, so stand back.
Stir in the butter and parmesan.
Add a splash of water if it gets too thick.

recipes.name: Refried beans
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) pinto beans, liquid saved
steps: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 4 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Add the garlic and cumin and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the beans and 1/2 cup of their liquid.
Mash with a potato masher as they heat for 5 minutes, adding more liquid until creamy.
Stir in the salt and top with cheese.

recipes.name: Baked beans
ingredients: 3 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) navy or great northern beans, drained
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Cook the bacon in an oven-safe pot for 5 minutes, then add the onion and cook for 5 minutes more.
Stir in the beans, ketchup, brown sugar, molasses, mustard, Worcestershire and water.
Cover and bake for 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake for 30 minutes more, until thick and bubbly.

recipes.name: Cuban black beans
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz / 425 g each) black beans with their liquid
steps: Heat the oil in a pot and cook the onion and pepper for 5 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Add the garlic, cumin and oregano and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beans, bay leaf, vinegar, sugar and salt.
Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick.
Take out the bay leaf. Serve over white rice.

recipes.name: Herb bread stuffing
ingredients: 1 loaf (1 lb / 450 g) white or French bread, cut in 1 inch cubes
2 cups (480 ml) chicken or vegetable broth
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Spread the bread cubes on 2 baking sheets and bake for 15 minutes to dry them.
Melt the butter in a pan and cook the onion and celery for 8 minutes, until soft. Ask an adult to help.
Stir in the sage, thyme, salt and pepper.
Whisk the broth and egg.
Toss the bread with the vegetables, broth mix and parsley in a big bowl.
Spread in a greased 9 by 13 inch dish and cover with foil.
Bake for 30 minutes, then uncover and bake for 15 to 20 minutes more, until golden on top.

recipes.name: Yorkshire puddings
ingredients: 4 tablespoons vegetable oil or beef drippings
steps: Whisk the flour, eggs, milk and salt until smooth. Let rest for 10 minutes.
Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Ask an adult to help.
Put 1 teaspoon oil in each cup of a 12-cup muffin pan and heat it in the oven for 10 minutes, until smoking hot.
Have an adult take out the pan and quickly pour the batter into the hot oil, filling each cup halfway.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until puffed and deep golden. Do not open the oven.
Serve right away with gravy.

recipes.name: Hush puppies
steps: Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, salt and garlic powder.
Stir in the green onions, egg and buttermilk until just combined. Let sit for 5 minutes.
An adult should fry. Heat 2 inches of oil to 350°F (175°C).
Drop tablespoons of batter into the oil a few at a time.
Fry for 2 to 3 minutes, turning, until deep golden.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.

recipes.name: Creamed corn
ingredients: 4 cups (600 g) corn kernels, fresh or frozen
1 cup (240 ml) heavy cream or milk
steps: Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat and stir in the flour for 1 minute. Ask an adult to help.
Slowly stir in the cream.
Add the corn, sugar and salt.
Simmer for 5 to 8 minutes, stirring, until thick and the corn is tender.
Stir in the parmesan.

recipes.name: Corn on the cob
ingredients: 6 ears of corn, husks and silk removed
steps: Bring a big pot of water to a boil. Ask an adult to help.
Add the corn and boil for 4 to 5 minutes, until bright yellow and tender.
Lift out with tongs and let drain.
Spread with butter and sprinkle with salt.

recipes.name: Elote
ingredients: 2 tablespoons Mexican crema or sour cream
steps: Have an adult grill the corn over medium high heat, or broil it, for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until charred in spots.
Mix the mayo and crema.
Brush it all over the hot corn.
Roll the corn in the cotija.
Sprinkle with chili powder and cilantro and serve with lime wedges.

recipes.name: Parmesan roasted broccoli
ingredients: 2 heads broccoli (about 1 1/2 lb / 680 g), cut into florets
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Toss the broccoli with the oil, garlic, salt and pepper on a baking sheet.
Spread it out so the pieces do not touch.
Roast for 18 to 22 minutes, until the edges are crispy and brown.
Sprinkle with parmesan and squeeze the lemon over it.

recipes.name: Garlic butter green beans
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) green beans, ends snapped off
steps: Boil the green beans in salted water for 3 minutes. Ask an adult to help drain them.
Melt the butter in a big pan over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, until it smells good.
Add the beans and toss for 2 to 3 minutes.
Season with salt and lemon.

recipes.name: Green bean casserole
ingredients: 1 can (10.5 oz / 298 g) condensed cream of mushroom soup
4 cups (about 450 g) cooked cut green beans, or 2 cans (14.5 oz each), drained
1 1/3 cups (75 g) French fried onions, divided
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Stir the soup, milk, soy sauce and pepper in a 1 1/2 quart baking dish.
Stir in the green beans and 2/3 cup of the fried onions.
Bake for 25 minutes, until hot and bubbly.
Stir, then top with the rest of the fried onions.
Bake for 5 minutes more, until the onions are golden.

recipes.name: Roasted Brussels sprouts
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) Brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Have an adult trim and halve the sprouts.
Toss with the oil, salt and pepper.
Lay them cut side down on a baking sheet.
Roast for 20 to 25 minutes, until deep brown and crispy.
Toss with the balsamic and honey.

recipes.name: Honey glazed carrots
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) carrots, sliced into 1/4 inch coins, or baby carrots
steps: Put the carrots, water, butter and salt in a pan.
Bring to a simmer, cover and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, until tender. Ask an adult to help.
Uncover, add the honey and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring, until the water is gone and the carrots are shiny.
Sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.name: Roasted asparagus
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Snap off the woody ends of the asparagus. They break off in the right spot on their own.
Toss with the oil, salt and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast for 10 to 12 minutes, until tender and a little browned.
Sprinkle with parmesan and squeeze lemon over it.

recipes.name: Garlic sauteed spinach
steps: Heat the oil in a big pan over medium heat. Ask an adult to help.
Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the spinach a handful at a time, tossing with tongs as it wilts.
Cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until all the spinach is wilted.
Season with salt and lemon. It shrinks a lot.

recipes.name: Creamed spinach
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
steps: Melt the butter in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 3 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Add the garlic and flour and stir for 1 minute.
Slowly stir in the milk and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until thick.
Stir in the spinach, parmesan, nutmeg and salt.
Cook for 2 minutes, until hot.

recipes.name: Roasted cauliflower
ingredients: 1 head cauliflower (about 2 lb / 900 g), cut into florets
Chopped parsley and a lemon wedge
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Toss the cauliflower with the oil, salt, garlic powder and paprika.
Spread on a baking sheet so the pieces do not touch.
Roast for 25 to 30 minutes, turning once, until golden and tender.
Sprinkle with parsley and lemon juice.

recipes.name: Parmesan zucchini spears
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Cut each zucchini in half lengthwise, then in half again to make spears.
Lay them cut side up on a lined sheet and brush with oil.
Mix the parmesan, garlic powder, Italian seasoning and salt and sprinkle over the tops.
Roast for 15 to 18 minutes, until tender and the cheese is golden.

recipes.name: Ratatouille
steps: Have an adult help chop the vegetables into small cubes.
Heat the oil in a big pot and cook the onion and pepper for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and eggplant and cook for 5 minutes, stirring.
Add the zucchini and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomatoes, thyme and salt.
Simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, until everything is soft.
Stir in torn basil.

recipes.name: Garlic bok choy
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) baby bok choy, halved lengthwise and washed
steps: Heat the oil in a wok or big pan over medium high heat. Ask an adult to help.
Add the garlic and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the bok choy and toss for 2 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, oyster sauce and water, cover and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until the stems are just tender.
Drizzle with sesame oil.

recipes.name: Maple roasted butternut squash
ingredients: 1 butternut squash (2 to 3 lb / 900 g to 1.4 kg)
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Have an adult peel the squash, cut it in half, scoop out the seeds and cut it into 1 inch cubes. It is hard to cut.
Toss with the oil, maple syrup, salt and cinnamon.
Spread on a lined baking sheet.
Roast for 30 to 35 minutes, flipping halfway, until tender and caramelized.

recipes.name: Garlic butter mushrooms
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) cremini or white mushrooms, sliced
steps: Heat the oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a big pan over medium high heat. Ask an adult to help.
Add the mushrooms in one layer and leave them alone for 3 minutes, until browned underneath.
Stir and cook for 4 to 5 minutes more, until golden and the liquid is gone.
Add the rest of the butter, the garlic and thyme and cook for 1 minute.
Season with salt and parsley.

recipes.name: Buttered peas with mint
steps: Put the peas and water in a pot and bring to a simmer. Ask an adult to help.
Cover and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until hot and bright green.
Drain off any water left.
Stir in the butter, salt, sugar and mint.

recipes.name: Sweet fried plantains
ingredients: 3 very ripe plantains, with mostly black skins
steps: Cut the ends off the plantains, slit the skin and peel it off.
Slice them on a slant into 1/2 inch pieces.
Heat the oil in a big frying pan over medium heat. Ask an adult to help, the oil can spatter.
Fry the slices for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until deep golden and caramelized.
Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with salt.

recipes.name: Tostones
ingredients: Dip: 2 garlic cloves, minced, 2 tablespoons olive oil, 1 tablespoon lime juice
steps: Cut off the ends, slit the skin lengthwise and peel. Green plantains are stiff, so ask an adult to help.
Cut into 1 inch thick pieces.
An adult should fry. Heat 1/2 inch of oil in a frying pan to 350°F (175°C).
Fry the pieces for 3 to 4 minutes, turning, until pale golden. Drain.
Smash each piece flat with the bottom of a glass.
Fry again for 2 to 3 minutes, until crisp and golden.
Drain, sprinkle with salt and serve with the garlic dip.

recipes.name: Crispy onion rings
steps: Have an adult slice the onions 1/2 inch thick and separate the rings.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and salt. Toss the rings in it and shake off the extra.
Whisk the egg and milk into the leftover flour to make a batter.
Dip each ring in batter, then press into the panko.
An adult should fry. Heat 2 inches of oil to 365°F (185°C).
Fry a few rings at a time for 2 to 3 minutes, until golden.
Drain on paper towels and sprinkle with salt.

recipes.name: Southern collard greens
ingredients: 2 lb (900 g) collard greens, stems removed, chopped
steps: Cook the bacon in a big pot over medium heat for 5 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes, then the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the greens a handful at a time, stirring as they wilt.
Add the broth, vinegar, sugar, red pepper flakes and salt.
Cover and simmer for 45 to 60 minutes, until very tender.

recipes.name: Quick refrigerator pickles
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) small pickling cucumbers, sliced into spears or rounds
2 teaspoons dill seed or 4 sprigs fresh dill
steps: Pack the cucumbers, garlic and dill into a clean quart jar.
Heat the vinegar, water, sugar and salt in a pot, stirring, until dissolved. Ask an adult to help.
Pour the hot brine over the cucumbers so they are covered.
Let cool for 15 minutes, then put the lid on.
Chill for 2 hours. They taste even better the next day and keep for 2 weeks.

recipes.name: Pickled red onions
steps: Have an adult slice the onion into thin rings.
Pack the onion into a jar.
Stir the vinegar, warm water, sugar and salt until dissolved.
Pour it over the onions.
Let sit for 30 minutes, until bright pink. Keep in the fridge for up to 2 weeks. Great on tacos.

recipes.name: Korean seasoned spinach
ingredients: 1 teaspoon soy sauce, or 1/2 teaspoon salt
steps: Bring a pot of water to a boil. Ask an adult to help.
Add the spinach and cook for 30 seconds, until just wilted.
Drain and rinse in cold water.
Squeeze out as much water as you can with your hands.
Toss with the soy sauce, garlic, sesame oil, sesame seeds and green onion.
